claims.value: 62 DDA runs from paired human retina and hippocampus across Alzheimer disease/control and two extraction methods.
claims.evidence: RAW names identify donor, retina/brain arm and extraction; the deposited results workbook maps abundance columns to Alzheimer disease/control, retina/brain, extraction and donor.

limitations: Sample-level age, sex and ancestry are not available.
The reconciler flags hippocampus against filenames containing Brain; hippocampus is retained because it is the more specific tissue stated by the study record and publication.
